description.value: Best Western Plus Revelstoke sits on Laforme Boulevard and positions itself as an adventure basecamp for visitors to the region, with direct access to the TransCanada Highway corridor and proximity to Revelstoke Mountain Resort and the Revelstoke Highline suspension bridge. The lobby is anchored by a hand-carved grizzly bear, and the property offers complimentary breakfast and free high-speed internet. It is a well-situated overnight stop for TransCanada touring cyclists passing through Revelstoke.
